spec.name: seethrough-apc-behind-truck
spec.note: Positive vehicle control: tall fire engine across the camera-to-APC sightline at (3.5,3.5), yaw 45. Its transverse hull stays clear of APC and sedans while actually obscuring the APC at all zooms; the old (4,4), yaw 0 pose leaves it unobstructed. Same camera and subject as opaque-sedan control.
